findings.detail: 22 HoldCo Limited senior subordinated loan has a source coupon of 12.24 % PIK, but the extracted private-credit row has blank interest_rate and basis_spread.

rationale: Class 2 row-validation issue: the bundle flags private-credit rows with missing rate fields. The raw SOI row for 22 HoldCo Limited discloses a coupon of 12.24 % PIK with SONIA reference and 7.50 % spread, while the corresponding extracted holding in the bundle has interest_rate blank. This grounds a real extraction gap, although not every one of the 67 flagged rows was independently proven from the sampled source rows.
